item.title: Hull crowned the fourth most affordable UK city for a Sunday roast
item.description: Deep-rooted in British culture, the beloved Sunday roast is far more than just a meal; it’s a cherished tradition. But with rising food prices, finding an affordable roast can be tricky. New research crowns Hull the fourth cheapest city in the UK for a roast, offering great value for Britain’s favourite dish. item.title: Hull City Council’s digitisation project for children’s services files delivers 300 new trees
item.description: Hull City Council has continued its move towards a greener, more efficient future by digitising thousands of historic children’s services files. The project, delivered in partnership with Hull-based company Storetec, recently led to 300 new trees being planted in Pickering Park.
